targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS total_wh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Joules_780' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km'))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Distance_Km' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND((d.dist_km / NULLIF((d.duration_s / 3600.0), 0))::numeric, 1) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM (SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') AS dist_km, (MAX(ts_session_ms::bigint) - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint)) / 1000.0 AS duration_s FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours')) d;

SELECT ROUND((d.dist_km / NULLIF(d.energy_kwh, 0))::numeric, 1) AS eff_km_per_kwh FROM (SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') AS dist_km, (MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600000.0 AS energy_kwh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours')) d;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lap_number) AS laps FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND(MAX(v * i)::numeric, 0) AS peak_power_w FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p;

SELECT ROUND((SUM(GREATEST(-(v * i), 0)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS regen_wh FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time) AS fault_samples FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Error_Count' AND value > 0 AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'GPS_Speed_Kmh') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", (AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') * AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780'))::double precision AS power_w FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Voltage_740') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Current_780', 'Current_740') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('MC_Temp_C', 'Batt_Temp_C') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", (AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') / NULLIF(AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') * AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') / 1000.0, 0))::double precision AS km_per_kwh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Speed_Kmh', 'Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1 HAVING AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh') > 1.0 AND AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') * AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') / 1000.0 > 0.5 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", (MAX(value) / 3600.0)::double precision AS energy_wh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Joules_780' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, MAX(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('GPS_Locked', 'GPS_Fallback_Active') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", MAX(value)::double precision AS gps_satellites FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'GPS_Satellites' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT lap_number::int AS lap, ROUND((MAX(ts_session_ms::bigint) - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint)) / 1000.0::numeric, 1) AS duration_s, ROUND((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km'))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km, ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS energy_wh, ROUND(AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh')::numeric, 1) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh')::numeric, 1) AS max_speed_kmh, ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km')) / NULLIF(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600000.0), 0))::numeric, 1) AS eff_km_per_kwh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY lap_number::int ORDER BY lap_number::int;

SELECT band, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN p < 0 THEN 'REGEN' WHEN p < 500 THEN '0-500 W' WHEN p < 1000 THEN '500-1000 W' WHEN p < 2000 THEN '1000-2000 W' WHEN p < 3000 THEN '2000-3000 W' ELSE '3000+ W' END AS band FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') * AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS p FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) s) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY band;

SELECT band, COUNT(*) AS samples FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN t <= 0 THEN '0%' WHEN t <= 25 THEN '1-25%' WHEN t <= 50 THEN '26-50%' WHEN t <= 75 THEN '51-75%' ELSE '76-100%' END AS band FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) AS t FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Throttle_Percent' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) s) t GROUP BY band ORDER BY band;

SELECT 'DRIVE' AS metric, ROUND((SUM(GREATEST(v * i, 0)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p UNION ALL SELECT 'REGEN' AS metric, ROUND((SUM(GREATEST(-(v * i), 0)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p;

list.definition: SELECT uid::text AS __value, COALESCE(session_name, uid::text) || ' | ' || to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

list.name: session_id
list.query: SELECT uid::text AS __value, COALESCE(session_name, uid::text) || ' | ' || to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;
